title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
HK DataCrest is a data and AI engineering company in Ahmedabad. We build production software for businesses in India and the United States \- data platforms, AI automation, business intelligence, and warehouse engineering on Snowflake, dbt and BigQuery. Our own product, Data Dock, is a natural\-language interface for data warehouses.

WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We need someone to find US companies who should be talking to us, write to them, follow up, and get a call in the diary.

You are not closing. You are not writing proposals or quoting prices. When a prospect is interested, you hand them to the founder with a short written brief and he takes it from there.

We are being specific about this because "business development" usually means five jobs in a trench coat. This is one job: get qualified conversations started.

THE PAY, SAID PLAINLY

Rs 30,000 per month, fixed. No commission, no incentive, no variable component.

We have deliberately moved away from a commission structure. You should not have to gamble on our sales cycle to earn a living, and we would rather pay you properly every month than dangle a percentage. What you see is what you get, from month one.

A DAY

Build and research the target list \- US companies, mostly mid\-size, using Apollo and LinkedIn. Work out who the actual decision\-maker is.

Write the first message. We have a library of tested templates you can start from, but a template sent untouched does not work and we will not ask you to send one.

Follow up. Most replies come from the second or third touch, not the first.

Handle the reply, qualify it against a short checklist \- the problem, the person, the timeline, the budget \- and book the call.

Log everything honestly in the CRM, including the ones that went nowhere.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

Written English that a US business owner will take seriously. This is the whole job and it is the thing we will assess hardest. Not formal, not flowery \- clear.

Comfortable with LinkedIn and Apollo, or able to become comfortable in a fortnight.

Consistency. Sending forty good emails a week, every week, when thirty\-five of them get ignored. That is the actual skill and it is rarer than it sounds.

Based in Ahmedabad and able to work on\-site, five days a week.

HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED

Lead generation or inside sales for an IT services or software company.

Any experience of the US market.

Familiarity with data or AI, enough to hold a short introductory conversation. We will teach you the rest.

No particular degree. No sales certification. No existing network \- nobody at this level has one.

BEING STRAIGHT ABOUT WHERE WE ARE

We are early. We do not have a long client list to point at, and the sales cycle for what we sell runs in weeks, not days. Some months you will book a lot of calls and close nothing. Your salary does not move either way \- that is the point of paying fixed.

What we do have is a researched target list, a tested message library, and a founder who will get on any call you book.

HOW WE HIRE

1\. You apply. We reply within 48 hours \- yes or no. We will not leave you waiting.

2\. A short paid task: find 15 US companies that fit our profile, and write the first message you would send to three of them. Paid because it is real work and it takes real time.

3\. One conversation, in person at our office in Ahmedabad.

4\. A decision within a week of that conversation.

TO APPLY

Email hkdc@hkdatacrest.com with the subject line: BDE \- Your Name

Attach your CV, and in the body write \- in under 150 words \- the cold email you would send to an operations manager at a US mid\-size company who has never heard of us.

We read that before we read the CV. It is the job.

HK DataCrest is an equal\-opportunity employer.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

Application Question(s):

* Our clients are US businesses. Write two or three sentences you would send, cold, to an operations manager at a mid\-size US company who has never heard of us.

This role sits at the intersection of sales and marketing. The ideal candidate should understand both how to identify and engage the right audience and how to convert early interest into qualified sales conversations. The candidate must possess a knowledge of how sales pipeline works and able to do calls to the interested prospects effectively.


You will be responsible for identifying potential customers based on Simform's Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), using data, automation, AI\-powered research, and intent signals to prioritize the right accounts and contacts. You will run and optimize multi\-channel outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, phone calls, and other relevant channels, conduct initial qualification conversations, and schedule qualified meetings with the appropriate closing representative.


This is not a traditional high\-volume cold outreach role. We are looking for someone who understands how modern AI\-enabled outbound systems work and can combine automation with research, personalization, and human judgment.


The role requires close collaboration with both Marketing and Sales to continuously improve ICP targeting, messaging, campaign performance, lead quality, and the conversion of outbound activity into qualified pipeline.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


**Prospecting and Lead Research**


* Identify/nurture target accounts and contacts based on defined ICP criteria, including firmographic, technographic, and other relevant data points

* Make contextual calls based on the identified relevant business triggers, intent signals, technology changes, hiring activity, growth signals, funding, website engagement, and other indicators of potential buying intent
* Score and prioritize accounts based on ICP fit, intent, engagement, and likelihood to convert
* Maintain clean and accurate prospect data across CRM through enrichment, verification, deduplication, and list hygiene processes
* Continuously identify new data sources, signals, and prospecting methods that can improve targeting quality

**Outbound Campaign Execution**


* Build, launch, and manage automated outbound campaigns across multiple channels, including email, LinkedIn, phone calls, and other relevant touchpoints
* Create relevant and contextual outreach based on the prospect's role, company, business priorities, and identified trigger signals
* Work with Marketing and Sales teams to develop and test messaging, value propositions, sequences, and campaign approaches
* Manage prospect enrollment, follow\-up cadences, suppression rules, and campaign workflows
* Monitor engagement signals and prioritize prospects showing higher levels of interest or intent
* Conduct A/B testing of messaging, subject lines, personas, triggers, sequences, and outreach approaches to improve campaign performance

**Lead Qualification and Discovery**


* Respond to interested prospects and conduct initial qualification conversations
* Understand the prospect's business challenges, priorities, current initiatives, requirements, and buying stage
* Assess fit against Simform's services, target customer profile, and qualification criteria
* Use consultative questioning and active listening rather than generic product pitches
* Identify relevant stakeholders and, where possible, understand the broader buying committee and decision\-making process
* Determine the appropriate next step and schedule qualified meetings with the relevant accounts

**Sales Handoff and Pipeline Support**


* Ensure qualified prospects are handed over with complete account and conversation context
* Maintain accurate records of prospect research, engagement history, qualification details, stakeholder information, and next steps
* Provide the closing representative with relevant context before scheduled meetings
* Work closely with the sales team to gather feedback on lead quality and improve qualification criteria
* Track whether meetings progress into qualified opportunities and use this feedback to improve prospecting and targeting

* Collaborate with Marketing on account targeting, campaign audiences, intent data, website visitor insights, and outbound campaigns
* Support the development of repeatable outbound playbooks and workflows
* Help improve the connection between marketing\-generated signals and sales outreach

* Identify opportunities to reduce manual prospecting work through automation while maintaining quality and relevance
* Work with CRM and marketing automation systems to ensure prospect and campaign data remains accurate and actionable

title: Sales Executive
description:
**What you will be selling**

This is a SaaS sale, not a product or commodity sale. You are selling a subscription\-based software platform to business owners who are used to doing things manually. You must be comfortable selling technology, running a live demo, and explaining a system, not just quoting a price.

Our company is a recurring\-revenue software platform with a web app and mobile app. Your prospects are pharmacy owners, district managers, and head\-office operations leaders, most of whom are not technical. Your job is to make a software solution sound simple, obvious, and worth switching to. If you have sold SaaS, IT services, or any technology product before, this will feel familiar. If you have only ever sold physical goods, this role will be a hard jump.

**The role — read this part carefully**

This is a phone\-first role. The majority of your day will be spent on the phone, cold calling pharmacy owners, managers, and decision\-makers across Canada. If you are not comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day, please do not apply.

You will own the full sales cycle — building your own call list, making the calls, handling objections on the spot, running the software demo, following up relentlessly, and closing the subscription. You will be the first voice a Canadian pharmacy hears from our company, so your English, your tone, and your ability to think on your feet directly determine whether we win that account or lose it.

This is not a role for someone who needs hand\-holding. We want someone who is self\-motivated, thinks creatively, takes initiative, and brings energy to the work every day.

**What you will do**

* Make a high volume of cold calls every day to pharmacy owners, managers, and head\-office decision\-makers across Canada. This is the core of the job, not a side task.
* Handle objections live on the call — price, timing, "we already have an agency", "we don't want another app", "send me an email", "not interested". You need answers ready and the confidence to keep the conversation going.
* Run online product demos over Zoom or Teams — walk a prospect through the platform, answer functional and basic technical questions, and connect features to the problems that pharmacies are actually facing.
* Learn the product deeply — you are expected to know the platform well enough to answer most questions yourself without escalating to the technical team.
* Own the end\-to\-end sales process — prospecting, calling, qualification, demo, negotiation, onboarding paperwork, and closing.
* Follow up by email, WhatsApp, and phone until you get a clear yes or a clear no. Deals are lost on follow\-up, not on the first call.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline in the CRM; keep call notes, statuses, and next steps accurate and up to date every day.
* Report your own numbers — calls made, connects, demos booked, and deals closed — without being chased for them.
* Feed real market objections and feature requests back to the product team so the platform keeps improving.
* Collaborate with the Client Success team to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding of new clients after signing.

**What we are looking for**

**Non\-negotiable requirements — please only apply if all of these apply to you.**

**SaaS or IT product and services sales experience — minimum 2 years actively selling software, subscriptions, platforms, apps, or IT services. Not lead generation for a software company; actual selling. Tell us what you sold, who you sold it to, and what the subscription or contract value was.**

**Ability to demo software confidently — you can run a screen\-share walkthrough of a platform, explain how it works to a non\-technical business owner, and handle questions such as "how does it integrate", "is our data safe", and "what if my staff can't use it" without freezing.**

**Comfort with technology — CRM, dialer, Zoom or Teams, shared docs, WhatsApp Business. You should be the kind of person who figures out a new tool on their own rather than waiting for training.**

**Excellent spoken English — clear pronunciation, neutral accent, and confident delivery. You will be on live calls with Canadian pharmacy owners and executives throughout the day. Weak or hesitant English will not work in this role, no exceptions.**

**Strong objection\-handling skills — you can stay calm when someone says no, ask the right question back, and turn a cold response into a conversation.**

**Proven cold calling experience — you have done outbound calling as a daily habit, not occasionally, and you can tell us your typical daily call volume.**

**Honesty and integrity — you report your numbers accurately, tell us when something did not get done, and never overstate a lead's interest to look good on a report.**

**Accountability and ownership — you own your targets and your results. When something goes wrong, you come with the problem and a plan, not an excuse.**

**Responsiveness is mandatory — you reply to emails, WhatsApp messages, texts, and calls from clients and from the team promptly during working hours. If you are someone who leaves messages unread and calls unreturned, this role is not for you.**

**Work ethic — this is a demanding, target\-driven role with real earning upside for people who put in the effort. If you are looking for an easy desk job where you can coast, please do not apply.**

**Onsite availability — this role is based at our office in Sargasan, Gandhinagar. Remote work is not available for this position.**

**Scheduling flexibility — our clients are in Canada. Calls and meetings will need to be scheduled in alignment with Canadian time zones, including Eastern and Pacific time zones. You must be genuinely flexible with your working hours on those days.**

**Punctuality and reliability — missed follow\-ups and late responses cost us deals. You must be disciplined, organised, and on time — always.**

**Strongly preferred**

Healthcare, staffing, HR tech, or marketplace SaaS experience — selling workforce, scheduling, HRMS, or ERP software is the closest match to what we do.

Experience with subscription and recurring\-revenue selling — you understand that the sale is not finished at signup and that renewals depend on how you set expectations up front.

Experience selling SaaS or IT services into North American markets — Canada or the US.

Hands\-on experience with CRM and sales technology — HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator (MUST), or similar.

Understanding of basic SaaS sales metrics — pipeline stages, conversion rates, MRR, and churn.

**Compensation**

**Base Salary:** Competitive fixed monthly salary.

**Commission:** Performance\-based commission with uncapped earning potential.

**Monthly Targets**

Your base salary covers your fixed monthly income. On top of that, you earn commission on every deal you close — the more you sell, the more you earn. There is no cap on what you can make. Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.
